## Function Run Scout

One recon session — round 0, then one model turn per round through the processor, read as an action or an answer, until an answer, a closed budget or a failed call.

Behaviour: runScout(session {question, tree, fs, seedText, budgets, caps, maxTokens}, deps {config, transport, now}) → Promise of {status "ok" | "no_answer" | "invalid_answer", answer | null, stopReason, spent, elapsedMs, usage {requests, inputTokens, outputTokens, cost}, journal, messages}. PROTOCOL = the text of tests/fixtures/scout/protocol.txt exactly; REMINDER = "One line per turn: READ <path> [<from>-<to>], GREP <pattern> [-- <dir>], LIST [<dir>] or ANSWER {json}.". openingMessages(session) = [{system, PROTOCOL}, {user, (seedText + "\n" unless "") + Run Tool's LIST "" text (session caps) + "\n\nTask:\n" + question}]; round 0 is not charged. start = now(); spent zero; usage {0, 0, 0, cost null}. Round r = spent.rounds + 1: one request {customId "scout.t<r>", model null, maxTokens, reasoning null, messages: a copy} through processor Send Generation(config, [request], transport); usage adds its tokens and its cost (null until one request reports a cost); every round one journal entry {round, turn "action"|"answer"|"malformed"|"failed", action | null, chars, error | null, inputTokens, outputTokens, cost} of that request. An answer error → turn failed, no_answer "no answer: the model call failed in round <r>: <error>". Else its text (null → "") is the next assistant message, Parse Turn reads it, elapsed = now() − start. An ANSWER → checkAnswer(answer, tree, fs): each target, then each context_slice path through Cage Path (file), the first refusal → {ok false, error "targets: " | "context_slice: " + its error}; else the caged paths, repeats dropped, slice paths that are targets dropped, reasoning kept. Valid → charged (call false, read false, text ""), chars 0, ok, Spend Budget's stopReason(true, closed, why) of the budget closed before. Rejected after the final turn → invalid_answer "no answer: the answer after the budget closed was rejected: <error>"; rejected again after a correction → invalid_answer "no answer: the corrected answer was rejected: <error>" (both charged with ""); the first rejection is charged with the reply "ANSWER rejected: <error>. Name only files of the tree and send ANSWER again." After the final turn an action or a malformed turn → charged with "", chars 0, no_answer "no answer: the model did not answer after the budget closed: <why>". An action → Run Tool, charged (call true, read, its text), error = its error; a malformed turn → charged (false, false, "Turn not understood: <reason>. " + REMINDER), error = the reason. The delivered text is the next user message and the entry's chars. A budget the turn closed: deadline or rounds → no_answer stopReason(false, closed, why) after that message; calls, reads or chars → the message gains "\n\nThe budget is closed: <why>. No more tools will run: send ANSWER now, the JSON object last." and the next turn is the final one. now() is called at the start, after each reply without an error, and once at the end (elapsedMs).
